title: Investigate initial installed CLI smoke-test export loss
description:
During owner-approved live verification on 2026-10-31, first short Pi CLI synthetic session ca70 exited0 but emitted fixed degraded warning and persisted no records. Two subsequent fresh processes (ca71, ca72) passed, including unmodified installed package with no diagnostic extension. Cause unproven; tight100ms RPC/150ms processor deadlines and cold module loading are hypotheses only. See docs/live-verification.md. Reproduce at real enabled CLI boundary before changing timeouts/transport; preserve bounded natural shutdown and metadata privacy. Do not change services or installed package. Request fresh approval before more live writes; prefer independent loopback regression. No speculative production seam.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Investigate through a real enabled Pi CLI with an isolated synthetic provider and loopback receiver; distinguish cold-load, export deadline and transport behavior without assuming a cause.
- If reproduced, demonstrate an independently meaningful CLI-boundary regression failing before any fix and passing afterwards, without duplicating SDK-only coverage or adding test-only production seams.
- Preserve private official exporters, metadata privacy, fixed diagnostics, sticky loss and natural bounded shutdown; run ordered format/check/test gates for any code changes.
- If not reproduced, record bounded attempts and remaining uncertainty explicitly rather than claiming a diagnosis or changing timeout constants speculatively. Obtain separate approval before more live pipeline writes.
notes: Additional observation during metadata-expansion planning: no production/test changes, ordered make format/check passed; full make test had 1 integration failure in tools scenario at empty-stderr assertion (fixed degraded telemetry-loss diagnostic). Other26 integration +unit1 passed. Immediate focused rerun of tools file passed2/2. No cause established, no equivalence claimed with initial CLI failure, no timeout/service changes made.
